title: Senior CRM Manager - Automation & AI
description:
Lingokids is on a mission to help families raise amazing kids through Playlearning™. Ready to join us on this exciting journey? 🚀
We're Lingokids , the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love.
Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.
20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we’ve earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.
You in? Keep on reading.
Are you ready for Playlearning?™
Twenty million families open Lingokids every month, and each one is a different kid at a different point in their learning.
As Senior CRM Manager , you'll own how we talk to all of them across email, push, and in-app messaging . You'll build the automation and AI layer that keeps it personal at that scale: journeys that adapt to how each family actually plays and learns, audiences and content selected and generated automatically, and experimentation that runs continuously so the programme gets sharper every week.
You will own CRM as a domain end to end: the roadmap, the priorities, and the projects that run across Product, Data and Design.
What you'll do

• Own and evolve our Braze setup. Canvases, journeys, segmentation, Liquid, connected content, API triggered campaigns and webhooks.

• Design lifecycle automation that replaces manual work. Self-optimising journeys across onboarding, free-to-paid conversion, retention and win-back, with a clear view of which decisions the system should make on its own.

• Put BrazeAI to work. Get real value out of the Intelligence and Predictive suites (intelligent timing, channel and variant selection, churn and event prediction), evaluate what's worth turning on next, and be honest about where these features add value and where they don't.

• Use AI tooling to scale production and personalisation. Generating and adapting copy and creative variants, building localised versions, and automating QA so that quality goes up as volume goes up.

• Build the system, not just the campaigns. Reusable components, templates, naming conventions and documentation, so that builds get faster and more consistent as the programme grows.

• Partner with Data to feed better signals into CRM: event design, model outputs, audience syncs, and reporting we can actually trust.

• Run a continuous experimentation programme (A/B, multivariate, holdout groups) and make sure the learnings change the next journey rather than sitting in a deck.

• Own quality and governance end to end. Copy, rendering, links, deliverability, error handling, and consent and privacy compliance. We talk to grown-ups about their children, so the bar here is higher than in most CRM roles.

• Report on CRM's contribution to conversion and retention, with commentary and recommendations a non-CRM colleague can act on.

• Keep us current. Bring in what's working elsewhere in lifecycle marketing and AI-assisted CRM, and tell us what we should stop doing.

What we're looking for

• 5+ years in CRM, lifecycle or marketing automation , with hands-on ownership of a marketing automation platform.

• Braze specifically. Canvas, Liquid, connected content, API campaigns, catalogs. You've built in it, not briefed someone else who did.

• Demonstrable experience with automation and AI in a CRM context. For example: predictive audiences, AI-assisted content and variant generation, automated QA or localisation, self-optimising journeys, or LLM-based workflows connected to your CRM stack. We care more about what you built and what changed as a result than about which tools you used.

title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
tags: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
description: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication - particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) - remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic-electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains. Lightspeed is looking for a Field Sales Account Executive, to join our growing UK Hospo team. You will be implementing a strategy that will require you to have a physical presence across Glasgow. Each month you will drive the sales cycle from lead generation, to demonstrations, to closing deals.

Lightspeed’s Hospitality team is now in hyper-growth mode. Our process has been refined and optimised at a smaller scale in the last few years, now is the time to expand our team and our reach.

What you’ll be doing:

- Becoming an expert in the UK Hospo industry

- Monitoring the organisation’s competitors, their products and marketing strategies

- Researching and forecasting sales and developing sales strategies and methods and evaluating their effectiveness based on your catchment area

- Converting prospects into successful customers through customer sales methods such as door-to-door, cold calling and presentations - all in person.

- Carrying out the whole sales cycle which includes identifying and developing leads, meeting with your clients, creating value propositions, structuring financial deals, negotiating contracts, and closing deals.

- Visiting customers on a regular basis to identify their business challenges & pain points

- Successfully running in person demonstrations of the hospitality product

- Maintaining up-to-date records within Salesforce CRM solution

- Processing sales quotes and deadlines in an accurate manner

- Working with the marketing and sales team on developing new strategies to grow our sales pipeline based on conversations and input you will be having in the market

- Driving performance to consistently meet monthly, quarterly and annual goals

- Create new business through network events

What you’ll be bringing:

- Relevant sales experience in a Field and outbound environment, preferably in a solution-sales / technology-related

- Strong experience in hospitality

- Strong understanding of sales development best practices

- Ability to manage time effectively and efficiently

- Excellent customer service and telephone skills, including strong listening, verbal and written communication

- Demonstrated ability to meet and/or exceed sales targets

- Experience using Salesforce or comparable CRM experience to manage and organise pipeline

- Proficiency in English, any other language is a nice to have

- An entrepreneurial and agile mindset, a bias toward action and an ability to pivot when needed to meet business needs and objectives

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here https://www.lightspeedhq.com/careers/.

title: Manager of Tax

Employee-teams get the training, resources, and support they need to deliver an exceptional care experience for clients and their families. Founded in Silicon Valley, TheKey has grown from a single location to service coverage throughout North America enabling clients to live life on their own terms, in their own homes.

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
Full-Stack AI Engineer (LLMs, AI Products & Full-Stack Development)
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
About the Role
At Pavago , one of our clients is hiring a Full-Stack AI Engineer to build and deploy production-ready AI-powered applications.
This role combines full-stack software engineering with applied AI to deliver scalable, secure, and user-friendly products. You’ll work across backend systems, frontend applications, AI pipelines, APIs, vector databases, and cloud infrastructure to transform AI prototypes into real-world solutions.
Responsibilities
AI & LLM Development

• Build and deploy AI-powered applications using OpenAI, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar technologies.

• Develop scalable AI inference APIs with FastAPI, Flask, or Node.js.

• Build AI assistants, chatbots, copilots, and intelligent workflows.

• Implement embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, and semantic retrieval using Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or similar platforms.

Full-Stack Development

• Develop frontend applications using React, Next.js, Vue, or similar frameworks.

• Build backend services, APIs, and microservices that integrate AI with business logic.

• Deliver responsive, scalable, and production-ready AI experiences.

Data Engineering & Infrastructure

• Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines and AI data workflows.

• Orchestrate workflows using Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

• Manage cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.

• Deploy applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

Performance & Reliability

• Monitor application performance, inference latency, uptime, and model reliability.

• Optimize AI systems for scalability, cost, and performance.

• Implement secure authentication, permissions, and API protection.

• Maintain compliance with industry security and privacy standards.

Collaboration

• Partner with product managers, engineers, and data teams to deliver AI-powered features.

• Translate prototypes into production-ready applications.

• Document systems and deployment workflows.

Required Experience & Skills

• 3+ years of software engineering experience with AI/ML integration.

• Strong Python and JavaScript/TypeScript skills.

• Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar AI frameworks.

• Experience deploying AI or LLM applications into production.

• Strong frontend experience with React, Next.js, Vue, or similar frameworks.

• Experience with APIs, vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.

• Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud platforms.

• Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD workflows.

Nice to Have

• Experience building AI-powered SaaS products.

• Experience with LangChain, AI agents, Vertex AI, SageMaker, Kubeflow, or MLflow.

• Experience with LLM fine-tuning and MLOps.

• Knowledge of microservices and serverless architectures.

• Startup or high-growth product experience.

What Success Looks Like

• Successful deployment of production AI features.

• Reliable, scalable, and secure AI systems.

• High application uptime and strong performance.

• Efficient, maintainable infrastructure.

• AI-powered features that deliver measurable business value.

Interview Process

• Initial Recruiter Screening

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

• Technical Assessment

• Client Interview

• Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply
Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video . It’s a short, self-recorded video that completes your application and allows hiring managers to get to know you before the interview process begins.
Rather than repeating your background during multiple screening calls, you’ll tell your story once, allowing future interviews to focus on meaningful conversations.
Don’t overthink it-you can record as many takes as you’d like before submitting. Your invitation will come from Spark Hire , so please check both your inbox

title: Scriptwriter - Storyby
Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?
Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.
La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.
Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1-2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.
Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage.
Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3-5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6-8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM.
À propos du projet PLEIADES
Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM.

Vos principales missions seront de :

• Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique

• Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

• Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris

title: Sr. Creative Director, Brand Experience, Toys & Games
description:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

 

THE GLOBAL CREATIVE TEAM

In a world where every interaction matters, we craft brand experiences that resonate across audiences and channels, fueling a lifetime of play. We turn every touchpoint, physical or digital, into a chance to spark wonder, build desire and drive business outcomes for our portfolio of iconic brands.

We operate as one global creative team, united by a shared vision, diverse perspectives and a belief that the best ideas can’t be confined by org charts or geographic borders. Our multi-disciplinary creative teams are driven by unbridled curiosity, bravery and an innate drive to FITFO.

About the role:

We are seeking a Sr. Creative Director, Brand Experience to lead the creative vision, development and stewardship of Hasbro’s iconic portfolio of toy and game brands across Action, Fashion, Preschool, Nerf, Play-Doh and Board Games. This leader will shape how our brands show up in the world; building distinctive creative platforms and identities that connect with consumers, stand out in culture and drive commercial impact.

Leading our front-end Brand Experience organization, you will set the creative vision for the portfolio and build the teams, standards and tools needed to bring that vision to life globally. You’ll partner closely with Brand Marketing, Product Design & Development, Commercial, Licensing and our Global Creative Studio to connect brand strategy to execution across every consumer touchpoint. The mandate is simple: build brands that cut through the noise and move with culture.

A day in the life:

• Set the creative vision for our toys and board games portfolio. Translating business, brand and commercial strategies into distinctive creative platforms that can scale globally.
• Own brand creative strategy across Action, Fashion, Preschool, Nerf, Play-Doh and Board Games, ensuring each brand has a differentiated and culturally relevant expression.
• Lead the front-end of brand development, including brand creative strategy, creative direction, visual and verbal identity, brand guidelines and creative toolkits.
• Build brands, not just campaigns. Establish enduring creative systems that strengthen brand equity while creating the flexibility to stay relevant across audiences and channels.
• Champion consumer and cultural insight as a creative catalyst. Ensure our creative work starts with a deep understanding of the audiences we serve.
• Partner with cross-functional partners to ensure brand vision translates with excellence across packaging, retail, digital, social, licensing and entertainment.
• Raise the creative bar. Establish clear standards for creative excellence and continually challenge our teams and partners to push beyond category conventions and the expected.
• Lead, inspire and develop a high-performing brand creative team with a culture of ambition, curiosity, collaboration and accountability.
• Influence at the highest levels of the organization, advocating for creative vision with senior leaders and bringing stakeholders along through clear, persuasive storytelling.
• Shape the future of creative at Hasbro, embracing emerging technology, AI and new modes of storytelling to evolve how we build brands and connect with consumers.

What you'll bring:

• 15+ years of progressive creative leadership experience within world-class consumer brands, creative agencies or similarly complex brand environments.
• Experience leading multi-brand portfolios and building distinctive brands that live across both commerce and culture.
• A body of work

title: Associate Director, Channel Sales
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Role Summary and Impact

We are seeking a dynamic, volume-focused, and results-driven sales hunter to join our Google partnership team. This Associate Director role is a critical closer position, primarily responsible for driving new revenue through Google Marketing Platform (GMP) license sales and leading new business development opportunities.

You will own and close a high volume of Google Marketing Platform (GMP) license deals (CM360, SA360, DV360, GA360) sourced through direct outreach, cross-sells, upsells, and referrals from our partners at Google. You will act as a transactional closer with speed and efficiency. In addition to this focus, you will also support the Head of Alliance Sales in closing larger, more complex consultative engagements and strategic technology solutions offered by Choreograph. This is a commission-based role where your success is directly tied to your performance. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-energy, and perpetually evolving environment, is motivated by exceeding sales quotas, and possesses a strong background in technical or partnership sales within the digital advertising ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate the development of new business opportunities through direct sales efforts, cross-selling, up-selling, and partner referrals.

• Own the full sales cycle for GMP license opportunities, from initial lead outreach to deal closure.

• Identify, Qualify, Propose, and Close opportunities, efficiently handing over to Business Managers and Technical Specialists for delivery.

• Act as a transactional closer, converting a high volume of leads with speed and efficiency before handing off to technical consulting and business management teams.

• Manage leads, sales pipeline, forecasts, and reporting in Salesforce.com, taking responsibility for a reliable pipeline forecast and ensuring data accuracy and clear visibility into performance.

• Build and nurture relationships with, and sell alongside, technology partners, specifically Google’s GCS & LCS teams, to map solutions, get offerings in front of key contacts, and generate a consistent lead pipeline.

• Develop connections with agency client leads across the WPP network to identify and unlock cross-sell and upsell opportunities.

• Work alongside, and in collaboration with Business Directors, to achieve annual targets.

• Support the Head of Alliance Sales on larger, strategic consulting engagements, assisting with workstreams and coordinating with technical experts to ensure seamless deal closure.

• Keep up to date with the latest industry knowledge and developments, participating in Google events and supporting outbound prospecting activities to help build the Google ecosystem of opportunities.

• Support Choreograph's positioning as a Tech & AI Consulting company, articulating our value proposition in the evolving marketing technology landscape.

Skills and Experience

• A "hunter" mentality: motivated by closing new business, comfortable with high-volume deal flow, and driven by commission-based compensation.

• 2-5 years of technical, channel, or partnership sales experience with a demonstrated track record of closing deals and consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

• Proven consultative sales record, ideally with Fortune 500 companies.

title: Pricing Strategist, GTM
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Pricing Strategist focused on GTM, you will help shape pricing strategy for B2B enterprise customers across our product portfolio. Working within Finance and partnering with GTM, Sales, and Product, you will focus on pricing analytics, price performance, and the effectiveness of credit programs while contributing to broader commercial strategy.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

title: Senior Back-End Software Engineer
description:
As an engineer at Bask you will work directly with the CEO and CTO to build and design the software infrastructure that will serve as the backbone of telehealth.
We are looking to expand our software engineers, seeking those with deep rooted entrepreneurial spirit.
Our serverless platform is a multi-tenant monorepo - Next.js and React on the front, tRPC and Prisma behind it, deployed on SST, TypeScript throughout. One engineer can follow a change from a form field to the database without crossing a team boundary. That's the point.
Engineering at Bask Health is AI-first and builder-led. Work starts with general understanding of problem, moves to tools like Claude and Cursor for further investigation, making a plan and building, tested on staging with realistic data, released to production, tested with real patient and care teams, and then back for systems and polish. AI is a default part of how we work, not a side experiment - because moving fast in healthcare requires every advantage.
We are looking for engineers who take end-to-end ownership, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building software that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.
What You'll Do

•
Design, build, and ship high-quality product experiences. Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production. Write elegant, well-tested code - we have a real test suite and we intend to keep it that way.

•
Work across the stack. Follow a feature from the interface through the API to the database. No handoffs, no waiting on another team.

•
Work AI-first with Cursor and Claude Code. Use LLMs as your starting point. Draft intent, explore implementations, scaffold components, and refactor with AI in the loop. Apply your own judgment to meet the quality bar healthcare demands.

•
Prototype fast and validate with real users. Build and test quickly with real patients and care teams. Use what you learn to refine before fully committing - especially in sensitive clinical contexts where getting it right matters.

•
Build for scale and own the codebase. Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship.

•
Make automation legible and trustworthy. Build systems that clearly communicate what AI and automation are doing on behalf of patients and providers. Earn trust through transparency, reliability, and thoughtful defaults.

•
Champion performance, accessibility, and reliability. Ship work that is fast, robust, and accessible. Partner across the team to debug, optimize, and raise the bar over time.

•
Share AI-native workflows. Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes.

We are a highly collaborative team.
Requirements
Who We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is a full-stack generalist, and has experience taking a product from 0-1 product. We're looking for someone who's entrepreneurial and willing to roll up their sleeves to get the work done, and passionate about our mission to build a platform that will intensely disrupt the healthcare industry.

• You are a highly skilled dev

• SST

• Drizzle

• Node

• AWS Services (SQS, EventBridge, Lambda etc..)

• SQL Databases

• Problem solving

• Database Schema Design

• You can work independently and are comfortable owning entire projects and or large areas of the code base
• Strong experience in building paid products and services is preferred.
• You are a strong communicator - you are able to clearly articulate technical problems, constraints and timelines.

ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a GTM Operations Analyst to join our CX Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll drive operational excellence across customer experience, retention, and lifecycle workflows, manage CRM systems and data integrity, build reporting dashboards, and translate operational data into actionable insights for proactive retention strategies. If you're excited about building scalable customer-facing processes and are passionate about customer experience and SaaS operations, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to
You’ll report to our GTM Operations Manager and work closely with teams in Customer success & Sales teams. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to operational health and data integrity. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across GTM to ensure success.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a GTM Operations Analyst, you will:

- Operational Reporting & Dashboards - Design, build, and maintain comprehensive operational dashboards in Looker, Vitally, or Power BI to track customer health, onboarding progression, risk signals, and lifecycle renewals.

- CRM Administration & Data Management - Manage HubSpot or Salesforce systems including field configuration, custom objects, data mapping, and user access management.

- Churn & Risk Analytics - Analyze customer usage patterns and behavioral indicators to identify at-risk accounts early and support proactive retention interventions.

- Process Optimization - Map and evaluate post-sales and CX workflows to identify bottlenecks and implement improvements across CX platforms.

- Stakeholder Collaboration & System Hygiene - Partner directly with CX leadership, Sales Operations, and GTM teams while conducting regular platform audits and workflow automations.

You can expect to work with the following tech stack: HubSpot, Vitally, Salesforce, Freshworks, Looker, Power BI, and SQL/Python tools.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- 3+ years as a CX Operations Analyst, Operations Specialist, Business Analyst, or similar role in B2B SaaS.

- Hands-on experience administering CRM platforms (HubSpot or Salesforce) and Customer Success tools (Vitally, Gainsight).

- Proficiency in building and maintaining business intelligence dashboards in BI tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau).

- Strong analytical skills, execution focus, and communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Nice-to-have: Proficiency with SQL or Python, workflow automation tools (Zapier/Make), and background in data governance.

- A strong background in customer success, sales operations, or customer analytics.

title: Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) - Boynton Beach, FL
description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62 K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of

title: NCDR CathPCI Registry Abstractor
description:
Why ADN? Join the American Data Network family and become part of an established, purpose-driven healthcare quality organization with more than 30 years of experience. At ADN, our work supports hospitals and healthcare clients in improving quality, patient safety, and clinical outcomes. We value integrity, accuracy, collaboration, and professionalism, and we are looking for experienced abstractors who take pride in producing high-quality work.
Position Summary: American Data Network is seeking experienced NCDR CathPCI Registry Abstractors to support accurate and timely cardiovascular registry abstraction for assigned healthcare clients. This role is ideal for candidates with recent, hands-on CathPCI abstraction experience who can independently review clinical documentation, apply registry specifications, and meet assigned deadlines with a high level of accuracy.
This is not a general data entry position. Candidates must have direct healthcare registry, clinical chart review, quality reporting, or data abstraction experience specific to NCDR CathPCI.
Position Details: ADN hires both contractors and full-time employees for Data Abstraction roles. Contractors must be available for a minimum of 15 hours per week.
Key Responsibilities:

• Reviews patient medical records and abstracts data for the NCDR CathPCI Registry.

• Applies registry specifications, definitions, inclusion and exclusion criteria, and abstraction guidelines accurately and consistently.

• Interprets clinical documentation related to cardiac catheterization, PCI procedures, diagnoses, treatments, outcomes, complications, and related quality measures.

• Enters accurate and complete data into assigned registry platforms, EHRs, vendor tools, or other data collection systems.

• Maintains a high level of abstraction accuracy, completeness, and attention to detail.

• Meets assigned productivity expectations, weekly progress goals, and internal and client deadlines.

• Participates in quality assurance activities, including feedback, correction, validation, and IRR reviews.

• Communicates professionally with account leads, team members, and client contacts when clarification is needed.

• Maintains strict confidentiality and complies with ADN, client, HIPAA, and data security requirements.

Qualifications:
Required:

• At least 2 years of recent NCDR CathPCI Registry abstraction experience.

• Ability to independently abstract CathPCI cases using registry specifications and clinical documentation.

• Strong understanding of healthcare quality reporting, registry abstraction, clinical documentation review, and medical record interpretation.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and follow-through.

• Comfort working in multiple EHRs, registry platforms, vendor tools, and data collection systems as assigned.

• Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.

• Contractors must have high-speed secure internet, a PC or laptop, and at least two monitors.

Preferred:

• Experience using the NCDR application, NCDR reports, and/or other related data collection tools.

• Experience with IRR, QA review, audit validation, and/or abstraction accuracy review.

Screening & Onboarding: Qualified candidates will complete an initial phone screen and a CathPCI-specific abstraction assessment. The assessment is designed to evaluate understanding of registry specifications, abstraction judgment, accuracy, and completion speed.
ADN does not provide basic CathPCI abstraction training, so candidates should already have the registry experience needed for the role. After hire, ADN provides onboarding to ADN processes, client systems, EHR access, documentation tendencies, and other client-specific workflows.

title: Senior Product Manager - Recruiter Experience (India)
description:
We're Karat , the world's largest interviewing company.

Karat is transforming organizations around the world. We provide a powerful system for technical leaders at companies like PayPal, Atlassian, and Citi who want to take control of how they hire top engineers, elevate their teams and contractors, and stay ahead. At the core of Karat ’s system are live, expert-led interviews, analytics designed to give leaders maximum visibility, and the most robust interview performance dataset in the world.

Come join our Product team

Our Product team is committed to driving forward Karat ’s mission to make interviews predictive, fair, and enjoyable. We are focused on providing deeper value to engineering and talent leaders, hiring managers, recruiters, candidates, and Interview Engineers.
What you will do
As Senior Product Manager, you will own the product vision, strategy, and execution for recruiter experience within the Karat Platform. You'll build experiences that give recruiters clearer visibility into their pipeline, faster ways to act on it, and less manual overhead - including exciting new ground in how strong candidates get matched to the right opportunity, not just the role they originally applied for. You'll collaborate across engineering, content, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver high-impact solutions for our recruiting customers.
This position requires a schedule that overlaps with U.S. business hours.

•
Product Strategy & Innovation: Define the roadmap for the recruiter-facing workflow and analytics experience; identify where better tooling, automation, and insight can save recruiters time and improve their day-to-day decision-making; explore new ways to surface and route strong candidates toward better-fit opportunities, both within a single hiring pipeline and across the broader set of roles we help fill.

•
Product Development & Execution: Prioritize features based on customer needs and business objectives; partner with engineering, content, and UX teams to deliver high-quality, enterprise-ready solutions, including integrations with customers' existing recruiting systems

•
Analytics & Insights: Design and refine the dashboards and reporting recruiters rely on to manage their workload; analyze usage data to understand where recruiters get stuck or drop out of a workflow; run experiments to test new ways of surfacing insight, reducing manual effort, and improving match quality between candidates and opportunities

•
Market & Customer Focus: Track performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities; partner with Go-to-Market teams on expansion strategies; build compelling business cases for new offerings, including entirely new ways of connecting candidates to opportunity.

The experience you will bring

• 5+ years of product management experience across B2B and B2C offerings, ideally with exposure to recruiting, HR tech, or matching/marketplace-style products

• Genuine passion for and track record of building B2B SaaS applications - comfortable running customer discovery calls and QBRs and translating enterprise feedback directly into product decisions

• Demonstrated experience designing analytics, dashboards, or workflow tools that measurably improved how a professional user did their job

• Excited by greenfield, 0-to-1 problems - this role includes building something genuinely new, not just optimizing what exists

• Comfortable holding your own in client meetings with recruiting and TA leaders at large enterprises

• Excellent communication skills; able to translate complex concepts for diverse stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams

This position is only available to candidates residing in Bengaluru (formerly known as Bangalore). While our team operates 100% remotely, we are currently limiting hiring to this specific location. We will not consider applications from other cities in India at this time.
Applicants, please note: we will not consider submissions that are not 100% in English.

title: Backend Engineer, Money Movement and Revenue Streams
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We're searching for a Backend Engineer to join the Bridge team, inside the Payments Money Movement team domain. As the name says, we connect Vinted Pay to the outside financial world. Bridge owns how money leaves the platform and reaches our members: bank accounts, payouts, and the migration from different payment service providers into Vinted Pay.

We're at an important stage. We're moving millions of members and their payment flows from external providers to Vinted Pay, with zero downtime and without losing a single transaction. At the same time, we're building new revenue streams on top of our payments capabilities. The systems we build now will carry Vinted Pay for years, so there's real architectural work here, not just feature delivery.

In this position, you’ll 

• Work in a cross-functional  team of 3-4 backend engineers, frontend engineers, engineering manager, product manager and decision scientist.

• Build migration, payout flows in Ruby, orchestrate them as durable Temporal workflows across services.

• Own topics end-to-end: from an ambiguous requirement to a written proposal, cross-team alignment, implementation, and monitoring in production.

• Work in AI-assisted way: agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex and others) are part of the daily workflow here - for building, debugging, investigating production issues, and writing docs. We expect you to use them well and make the team better at it.

• See your code affect millions of users almost instantly. Our main branch gets rolled out straight to production on each merge. We deploy many times per day.

• Work with diverse tech stack: Ruby language, MySQL, OpenSearch, Redis, Kafka, Temporal, Prometheus, Grafana. We don't expect you to be familiar with all of them beforehand, but we expect you will be excited to learn them fast.

• Write unit tests for all of the code you write and contribute to integration and E2E test writing and its usage.

• Take ownership of alerts and business metrics for your team to ensure our services achieve 99.99% availability.

• You will participate in on-call rotations to ensure our product performs well.

About you 

• You take ownership of features and projects from start to finish, you break problems down so others can tackle them too - not just you.

• You navigate ambiguity well - given a vague requirement, you extract the real need, propose a solution with trade-offs, and drive it to agreement.

• You think like a product engineer - you ask why before how, quest

title: Sales Engineer, New York City (Strategic)
locationText: Remote - New York City, New York
description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Location: New York City

Why You'll Love This Role

As a Solutions Engineer, you'll help customers solve hard data problems in complex environments, with real depth in how security teams work.
You will help customers understand their environment, define the right success criteria, and build confidence in an approach that works in practice rather than on a slide. That takes both sides of the job: leading discovery and connecting technical capability to business value, and bringing genuine depth in data architecture, integrations, and environment design.  

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

• Lead technical discovery to understand a customer's environment, requirements, constraints, and success criteria.

• Design customer-specific solutions that combine parts of the platform to fit real architectures and business outcomes.

• Own POV and POC execution end to end, keeping the evaluation tied to agreed success criteria.

• Build credibility directly with security practitioners, including analysts, detection engineers, and security operations leaders, in conversations about their workflow and not just their data pipeline.

• Handle most technical questions and objections yourself, pulling in specialists for edge cases and the hardest evaluations.

• Partner with your Regional Sales Manager on account strategy, opportunity planning, and technical win strategy.

• Build technical champions inside accounts, and expand relationships beyond the first champion when the decision requires it.

• Run the technical sales process with discipline, including CRM hygiene, MEDDPICC alignment, milestones, and follow-through.

• Contribute your expertise to other teammates on your regional SE team.Up to 30% Travel

• We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

• Security depth - For this opening, we are prioritizing security analyst workflow depth. (If you feel like you are a strong candidate with Observability or Telemetry Engineering depth, we'd still like to speak with you.)

Our team studies how these teams scale: what happens to performance, cost and coordination as the number of agents, the compute budget and the length of the task grow, and what has to change to keep getting returns from that scale. We build the platform and evaluations Anthropic uses to run and measure large agent teams, and other research teams build on them.

This role lives at the boundary between research and engineering. It is a generalist role on a small team: you'll design and run large experiments, build the systems they run on, and get to the bottom of surprising results. We often need to go from a vague question to a running experiment quickly.

Responsibilities:

• Design, run and interpret large-scale experiments on agent teams, reasoning rigorously about what the data does and doesn't show

• Investigate how performance and efficiency change as team size, compute and task horizon grow, and find the bottlenecks that limit them

• Build and scale the systems that run very large agent teams reliably, and debug the failures that only appear at scale

• Design evaluations for long-horizon problems, and keep their results trustworthy

• Build the tooling and metrics that let researchers see what a large agent team is doing and why

• Partner with research teams across Anthropic so they can run their own experiments on the platform, and communicate findings clearly

You may be a good fit if you:

• Have significant software engineering, ML or research engineering experience

• Have owned something substantial end to end, such as a large system, an evaluation or benchmark, an agent product, or a research project

• Genuinely enjoy both research and engineering work

• Think quantitatively about complex systems, and think twice before trusting a number

• Can work from a vague question rather than a spec

• Are results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact

• Have clear written and verbal communication

• Care about the societal impacts of your work

Strong candidates may also have:

• Experience building or operating large-scale distributed systems, such as schedulers, sandboxed code execution, or inference and RL infrastructure

• Built evaluations, benchmarks or harnesses for LLMs or agents

• Experience building complex agentic systems that use LLMs

• Experience with scaling laws or other large-scale empirical research

• A background in operations research, statistics, economics, physics, quantitative finance, or another field that models and optimizes complex systems

Strong candidates need not have:

• Formal certifications or education credentials

• Academic research experience or publication history

• Prior experience with multi-agent systems or reinforcement learning

Representative projects:

• Measure how performance scales with the number of agents on a hard problem, and explain where the curve bends and why

• Prepare our largest-ever agent run: find what breaks as team size and task length grow together, and fix it before launch

• Work out how to allocate a fixed compute budget across a team of agents to solve a problem fastest

• Build tooling that turns the activity of a large agent team into something a researcher can read in minutes

• Design a novel eval that distinguishes real gains in teamwork from artifacts of the evaluation setup

title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

The Role
Location: U.S. east coast remote or ability to work east coast hours.
Red Cell is seeking a strategic finance leader to support Red Cell and our portfolio companies. This individual will report to the Director of Finance and will work closely with the CFO and the Senior Leadership Team, playing a key role in shaping incubation strategy from a financial perspective.
The role will require this candidate to support several incubations at a given time, spanning various industries and stages (e.g., discovery to Series B). This is a highly visible role with direct exposure to how new ventures are built, funded, and scaled. You'll operate across two dimensions: an internal operating focus that keeps the company financially disciplined and decision-ready, and a strategic focus that connects finance to commercial strategy and market positioning.
We are looking for a diligent and execution focused individual who can own M&A and forecast initiatives while being a strong collaborator within the finance team.
What You’ll Do

•
M&A & Liquidity Events: Lead modeling for acquisitions, spin-offs, IPOs, and other liquidity events across our incubation portfolio, from initial modeling through close.

•
Comps Research and Analysis: Conduct comparable company analysis to benchmarks, inform M&A and fundraising processes, and provide market context for strategic planning.

•
Strategic Planning and Analysis: Build, own, and manage a variety of models for our incubations, including scenario planning and cash planning.

•
Unit Economics and Performance Metrics: Monitor core performance metrics such as ROI, gross margins, and CAC/LTV. Partner will sales, ops, and technical teams to collaborate on business economics.

•
Fundraising and Reporting: Prepare regular investment committee and investor materials in collaboration with the Director of Finance and the incubation leadership team.

The right candidate will have the ability to analyze key drivers of the business, drive thoughtful planning, and support optimal decision making.
Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in strategic finance, investment banking, or FP&A

• Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics (or similar)

• Demonstrate an ability to set objectives and goals and organize work appropriately to meet and exceed goals. Possess strong organizational and time management skills

• Ability to influence at all levels of the organization and work within a team

• Strong interpersonal skills to deal effectively, assertively, and confidently with a wide variety of people while building constructive relationships

• Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills

• Ability to think objectively and interpret meaningful themes from quantitative and qualitative data

• Ability to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into actionable information to drive results

• Highest standards of accuracy and precision; highly organized

• Strong analytical skills; ability to use rigorous logic and methods to solve problems

• Creative thinker; highly driven and self-motivated

• Articulate with excellent verbal and written communication skills; strong listening skills

• Effective in a variety of presentation settings from one-on-one to large groups - both internally and externally

• Discretion in handling confidential information

• Ability to manage multiple deadlines

Compensation: Competitive base salary plus bonus and equity. This represents the typical compensation structure for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

title: Campaign Specialist, QA
description:

Integrate is a B2B demand orchestration platform that helps enterprise marketing teams capture, validate, and activate leads across every channel - turning fragmented demand generation into a unified, measurable pipeline.

As a Campaign Specialist, QA you will conduct rigorous QA reviews on campaign deliverables to ensure consistency, compliance, and alignment with requirements. Reporting via a dotted line to a designated Team Lead, you will identify deviations, maintain trackers, provide weekly analyses, and support Team Lead responsibilities including SOP creation/updates under Manager/Lead supervision. This role focuses on driving process excellence, error reduction, and optimization across multi-channel campaigns, collaborating with clients, sales, and execution teams to uphold Integrate 's standards for lead quality and platform reliability.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct comprehensive QA reviews for campaign deliverables (e.g., creative assets, targeting setups, compliance checklists), ensuring consistency with campaign requirements and standards.

• Identify and document process and output deviations from quality standards, recommending optimizations, automation opportunities, or corrective actions.

• Maintain QA trackers and audit data to identify gaps, trends, and insights; deliver weekly analysis reports to Team Lead and relevant stakeholders.

• Support Team Lead with responsibilities such as error-tracking, check-ins, bandwidth monitoring, and task prioritization through QA-driven insights.

• Assist with SOP creation, updates, and documentation under Manager/Team Lead supervision to standardize workflows and reduce errors.

• Collaborate with Campaign Specialists, clients, and sales teams to resolve QA issues, validate fixes, and ensure seamless campaign launches.

• Monitor multi-channel campaign outputs for compliance (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and performance benchmarks, flagging risks proactively.

• Contribute to process automation initiatives by testing tools and providing feedback on QA-impacting features.

· Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

•
2+ years of experience in quality assurance, campaign review, or process auditing within a SaaS, marketing technology, or B2B lead generation environment.

• Strong attention to detail with proven ability to identify deviations, document findings, and suggest actionable optimizations.

• Experience maintaining trackers, dashboards, and delivering regular analysis reports (e.g., weekly summaries).

• Familiarity with multi-channel campaign workflows, compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and tools like Salesforce, Google Sheets/Excel, or QA platforms.

• Collaborative mindset with ability to support Team Lead duties in a dotted-line structure under Manager supervision.

• Analytical skills to audit data, spot trends, and recommend SOP/process improvements.

Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Air Mobility Group (AIRMOB) is responsible for developing and delivering Metrea’s aerial refueling (AAR) capabilities, ensuring the readiness and operational effectiveness of the tanker fleet. AIRMOB oversees fleet management, maintenance, and airworthiness, working to sustain and enhance refueling operations. It manages the integration of new processes and technologies, ensuring that tanker aircraft remain mission-ready through effective logistics, maintenance oversight, and regulatory compliance. By coordinating across various teams, AIRMOB ensures the fleet meets both current and future operational needs, supporting a range of specialized air mobility missions.

Position Summary

In this role, you will maintain the accuracy and integrity of aircraft maintenance records for AIRMOB’s aerial refueling fleet, ensuring every maintenance event is properly documented in AMOS and compliant with FAA requirements. You will handle daily records processing, data entry, document control, and filing while supporting the Records Manager in audits and quality reviews. You will be successful if you are organized, detail-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, compliance-driven environment where accuracy directly supports fleet airworthiness.

What You'll Do

• Enter maintenance work orders, log cards, and inspection records into AMOS on a daily basis

• Review maintenance documentation for completeness and accuracy before system entry

• Scan, index, and file technical records in both electronic and hard-copy filing systems

• Verify mechanic stamps, signatures, and required data fields on all maintenance forms

• Update aircraft and component tracking databases with current status information

• Track and document compliance with Airworthiness Directives (ADs) and Service Bulletins (SBs)

• Maintain deferred defect logs and MEL tracking documentation

• Research historical records to support maintenance planning and troubleshooting

• Generate routine AMOS reports including aircraft status and compliance summaries

• Coordinate with maintenance technicians to resolve documentation discrepancies

What You Bring

• High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s degree in aviation or a related field preferred

• Minimum 2-3 years of experience in aviation records management or maintenance administration

description:

About the RoleWe're looking for an AI Artist to join our art team behind Empire and Empire: Four Kingdoms at Goodgame Studios - part of the Stillfront Group. We've built AI into our production pipeline from the ground up - it's not a bolt-on here; it's how we make things.
The role is hands-on and production-focused. You'll use AI tools daily to create, refine, and deliver assets that match our recognisable medieval strategy art style - from in-game visuals to marketing content - always combining AI generation with strong artistic judgement and traditional tools to reach the quality bar our players expect.
This is a fully remote, permanent position for candidates based in Germany, Sweden, Spain, Bulgaria, or Malta (valid visa required). Alternatively, we welcome applications from Freelancers working within the German time zone.
What You'll Do

• Produce in-game and marketing assets end-to-end, from concept through final delivery, using AI-assisted workflows

• Build and maintain image and video generation pipelines in ComfyUI and other tools

• Combine AI outputs with Illustrator, Photoshop, and After Effects to reach production quality

• Create and animate assets using After Effects, drawing on a solid understanding of animation principles, cinematography, and visual composition

• Maintain visual consistency with the established Empire art style across asset types (characters, buildings, environments, props)

• Support marketing and communication visuals alongside in-game content

• Test, evaluate, and integrate new AI tools and models as they emerge (we expect this to be a meaningful part of the job)

• Collaborate closely with the rest of the art team, as well as Product, CRM, Game Design, and Developers

What We're Looking For
Game Art Background

• Professional experience in game development (mobile games / F2P / live service titles a plus)

• Portfolio that includes real shipped in-game assets - characters, buildings, environments, props, animations - from actual projects

AI & Pipeline Skills

• Solid hands-on experience with AI-driven visual production as part of a real production workflow

• Advanced ComfyUI skills: building, debugging, and optimising complex workflows; custom node setup; dependency management and troubleshooting

• Strong working knowledge of Midjourney, ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini for image direction and iteration

• LoRA training and workflow automation

Image & Video Generation

• Character consistency workflows (LoRA, reference-based / ControlNet-style setups)

• Image-to-image and image-to-video pipelines

• Upscaling and post-production workflows

Production Tools

• Production-level Illustrator and Photoshop skills - these are at the core of our workflow

• Solid After Effects skills, including animation - backgrounds and in-game animations

• Strong sense of cinematography and visual composition - understanding of how animation and film work, timing, camera, and storytelling through motion

Technical Mindset

• Comfortable running AI workloads on cloud GPUs (e.g. RunPod or similar)

• Pragmatic problem-solver - you iterate quickly and don't wait for perfect conditions

Mindset

• Hands-on, adaptable, and genuinely curious about where AI is going

• Strong visual judgement - you know when something looks right for the style and when it doesn't

• Clear communicator across creative and technical topics

• Organised and team-oriented - we don't work in silos. Everyone on the team maintains a global overview of what's in progress, takes ownership of features end-to-end, and helps coordinate the team's work. We expect each person to grow not just as an artist but as someone who can lead and organise a feature from start to finish.

Nice-to-Have

• Experience with ElevenLabs or other AI audio/voice tools

• Familiarity with 3D or multi-view → 3D pipelines (e.g. Blender, Maya)

• Experience producing social media or performance marketing content

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
OUR VISION

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10-20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $31M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own customers.

 

OUR VALUES

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story-interview with us to hear them!

- 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

- 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

- 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort-we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

- 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it-no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

 

ABOUT VITALIZE'S DESIGN TEAM

Design at Vitalize is grounded in a deep understanding of the people and systems that power healthcare. We spend time in hospitals, learn how work happens from the frontline to the C-suite, and use those insights to design products that make complex operational decisions easier. We care deeply about craft, but we believe great design starts with getting the workflow right-not just the interface. As a small team, we work closely with Product and Engineering, share work early, challenge each other’s thinking, and stay close to the customers using what we build.

THE ROLE

You’ll be the third product designer at Vitalize, joining at a stage where you’ll help define not just what we build, but how we design. You’ll set the design direction for our most complex and strategic product areas, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into clear, intuitive experiences.

We want design at Vitalize to be AI-first, and we’ll be honest: we’re not there yet. We’ve started using AI for early exploration and prototyping, but we don’t have a consistent workflow or clear best practices. A big part of this role is changing that. You’ll help define what an AI-first design process looks like here: how we use AI to explore more ideas, prototype faster, and get to real customer feedback sooner, without lowering the craft bar.

You’ll also shape how AI shows up in the product itself, design across data-dense, AI-powered workflows, lead the evolution of our design system, and set a consistently high bar for everything we ship as Vitalize scales.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build our AI-first design workflow: figure out how AI fits into every stage of our design process, from exploration and prototyping to production. Set the best practices, workflows, and quality standards the team adopts

- Lead by example: use AI daily to explore, prototype, and test ideas quickly, then bring the strongest directions to production quality

- Set design direction across the product: lead design for our most complex, cross-cutting product areas from discovery through launch, and shape the long-term product vision alongside Product and Engineering leadership

- Design complex, workflow-heavy experiences: make data-dense operational tools intuitive for users ranging from central staffing teams and unit managers to frontline clinicians

- Shape how AI shows up in the product: decide where AI meaningfully improves workflows and how its recommendations, reasoning, and actions appear, so clinical and operational user

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's System Safety Engineering organization partners across Anduril's engineering, manufacturing, and operations organizations to ensure our autonomous systems are safe for development, testing, and deployment in complex operational environments. Our mandate spans the complete product lifecycle, from early concept design through production scale-up and fielded operations. We make our products safe by guiding product teams through safety analyses such as: Functional Hazard Analysis, Fault Trees, Hazard Management and Hazard Mitigation activities, identifying hazards early and partnering with design teams to engineer safety into hardware, software, and operations.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking experienced System Safety Engineering leaders to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa, CA and drive system safety excellence across Anduril’s product portfolio. As a System Safety leader at Anduril, you will play a critical role in developing and implementing robust safety frameworks. Your expertise will be instrumental in guiding product teams through the System Safety lifecycle, from initial concept through design, qualification, production, and field deployment. You will drive continuous improvement initiatives, lead the development of risk mitigation strategies, and foster a safety culture across the organization. Leveraging your deep knowledge of system safety tools (FHA, FTA, SCFTA, SSA, FMECA, etc.) and hazard analysis methodologies, you will ensure that our systems operate safely under diverse and demanding operating conditions.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead and manage the performance of a team of System Safety Engineers, providing technical guidance and mentorship on system safety principles, best practices, and artifact development.

• Manage resource allocation and capacity planning to support multiple concurrent programs, and drive recruiting efforts to maintain growth trajectory.

• Conduct performance management, career development planning, and succession planning.

• Develop and implement tailored System Safety program plans aligned with MIL-STD-882E and the needs of Anduril and its customers.

• Define and communicate the System Safety organization's vision, goals, and framework to standardize development efforts across the business and integrate safety processes across all stages of product development.

• Oversee and review complex safety analyses, including FHA (Functional Hazard Analysis), Fault Tree, SCFTA (Safety Critical Functional Thread Analysis), and SAR (Safety Assessment Report).

• Develop system safety requirements and collaborate with design teams to implement safety solutions.

• Support Milestone Reviews such as PDR, CDR, and TRR representing System Safety.

• Liaise with customers, regulatory bodies, and internal stakeholders on safety-related matters.

• Drive continuous improvement in System Safety processes and methodologies.

• Ensure compliance with relevant military and industry safety standards.

• Contribute to proposal efforts and support business development activities, as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• B.S. Degree in Mechanical Enginee
